vocabulary_focus.concept: To troubleshoot / fix a technical issue

expressions.en: To troubleshoot / fix a technical issue
expressions.cn: 解决技术问题 (jiějué jìshù wèntí)
开发应用程序/系统 (kāifā yìngyòng chéngxù/xìtǒng)
在线平台 / 电子商务 (zàixiàn píngtái / diànzǐ shāngwù)
数据隐私 / 安全 (shùjù yǐnsī / ānquán)

work.scenario: You are in a team meeting discussing the progress of a new project and upcoming system changes. You need to talk about updating the current system and developing a new feature, while considering digital transformation.
key_phrases: Kita perlu mengemaskini sistem sedia ada.
Pasukan kami sedang membangunkan modul baru.
Adakah kita akan melaksanakan transformasi digital untuk proses ini?

life.scenario: Your phone is acting up, and you're chatting with a friend about it. You also mention buying something from an online store and being careful about your personal information.
key_phrases: Telefon saya asyik hang, kena betulkan masalah teknikal ni.
Saya baru beli barang dari platform online tu.
Kena jaga privacy data kita bila shopping online.

tech.scenario: You are a software engineer discussing the next phase of a product with your lead. This involves system upgrades and ensuring data security for the users, as part of a larger digitalization effort.
key_phrases: Cadangan untuk menaik taraf perisian ini sangat penting.
Bagaimana kita boleh memastikan keselamatan data pengguna?
Pendigitalan proses ini akan meningkatkan kecekapan operasi.
